items.stem: Which sentence correctly applies subject-verb agreement?

choices.A: The box of chocolates have been shared among the guests.
choices.B: The box of chocolates are shared among the guests.
choices.C: The box of chocolates were shared among the guests.
choices.D: The box of chocolates was shared among the guests.

The sentence 'The director called the actor before the show, and she was nervous' contains an ambiguous pronoun. Which revision makes the pronoun reference unambiguous? The text establishes that the actor was nervous.

choices.A: The director called the actor before the show, and one of them was nervous.
choices.B: The director called the actor before the show, and the director was nervous.
choices.C: The director called the actor before the show, and they were nervous.
choices.D: The director called the actor before the show, and the actor was nervous.
